invariants.claim: A successful purchase starts in Active before endTime, uses a nonzero recipient and positive entryCount, and leaves totalEntries within uint128 (Raffle.sol:L215-L221).
Each successful call assigns the next ticket ID and a nonempty range directly following the old total, then advances totalEntries and ticketCount once (Raffle.sol:L226-L232).
The recorded purchase liability increases by entryCount * ENTRY_PRICE before the ticket receiver callback (Raffle.sol:L223-L235).
Minting screens known protocol destinations and records ERC721 ownership before any code-bearing receiver is called (Raffle.sol:L497-L501; ERC721.sol:L259-L290).
The shared nonReentrant guard remains entered across both the quote-token call and receiver callback (Raffle.sol:L212-L235; ReentrancyGuard.sol:L69-L105).

assumptions.claim: An accepted SafeERC20 transferFrom result increases raffle quote-token custody by exactly grossAmount.
assumptions.establishedBy: Canonical fee-free quote-token trust requirement at IRaffle.sol:L12-L15 and DESIGN.md:L2; SafeERC20 itself checks return behavior, not balance delta (SafeERC20.sol:L212-L244).

assumptions.claim: The configured quote-token address is the target chain's official USDC.
assumptions.establishedBy: Deployment tooling is assigned this check at IRaffleFactory.sol:L7-L9; onchain construction establishes only code presence and six decimals at RaffleFactory.sol:L66-L78.

assumptions.claim: ticketId is fresh and ticketCount cannot outrun totalEntries.
assumptions.establishedBy: Both clone values start zero; only buyEntries writes them, each successful call adds at least one entry and exactly one ticket, and the uint128 entry bound is checked at Raffle.sol:L218-L232.

assumptions.claim: A contract recipient's successful callback establishes ERC721 acceptance, but does not establish that recipient remains owner when buyEntries returns.
assumptions.establishedBy: Ownership is written before callback at ERC721.sol:L216-L244 and L287-L290; public inherited approval/transfer entrypoints remain callable at ERC721.sol:L92-L136; ERC721Utils checks only callback return/revert behavior at L32-L47.

assumptions.claim: Canonical factory getter calls used by destination screening return the fixed implementation and current registration bit without callback behavior.
assumptions.establishedBy: Public immutable/mapping declarations at RaffleFactory.sol:L41-L54 and writes at L89-L91, L105-L125.

calls.propagates: Rejects nested protected calls, writes ENTERED before the body, and restores NOT_ENTERED after normal completion (ReentrancyGuard.sol:L69-L105).
Continuation establishes current status equals Active; mismatch reverts with actual status (Raffle.sol:L215, L571-L575).
Bubbles a failed token call, accepts returned true or code-bearing empty return, and rejects other return outcomes; it does not verify a balance delta (SafeERC20.sol:L40-L47, L212-L244).

Receives msg.sender, this raffle, and grossAmount before purchase writes; exact fee-free movement is trusted, while revert, nonstandard return, and re-entry are external outcomes (Raffle.sol:L223-L224; IERC20.sol:L69-L78).
Dispatches through Raffle._update, requires a previously unowned token ID, then runs receiver acceptance with empty data (ERC721.sol:L259-L290).
Rejects local protocol plumbing, implementation, prize token, wrapper, and registered raffle destinations before delegating the ledger update (Raffle.sol:L497-L502, L593-L605).
Supplies immutable implementation identity and registry membership used by destination screening (RaffleFactory.sol:L41-L54, L89-L91, L105-L125).
On mint, increments recipient balance, writes ownership, emits Transfer, and returns the previous owner for the freshness check (ERC721.sol:L216-L267).

Skips code-less recipients; for code-bearing recipients accepts only the selector, maps empty failure to invalid receiver, and bubbles nonempty reverts after ownership/accounting writes (ERC721Utils.sol:L25-L48).

callers: Any external address may call directly subject to lifecycle, time, input, payment, destination, and receiver gates (Raffle.sol:L209-L237; IRaffle.sol:L310-L314).
No internal target callsite exists; the other target occurrence is the ABI declaration (IRaffle.sol:L314).
sharedState: status and endTime: read at Raffle.sol:L215-L216; established/transitioned at L197-L205, L240-L300, L421-L430, L509-L523.
totalEntries, ticketCount, _ticketRanges: written at Raffle.sol:L226-L232; consumed at L243, L280-L287, L362-L369, L451-L455, L518-L521, L538, L579-L584.
unsettledPot and quote-token custody: increased at Raffle.sol:L223-L233; transformed or paid through L296-L299, L339-L342, L367-L390, L539-L555.
ERC721 ownership/balances/approvals: mint reaches ERC721.sol:L216-L290; inherited transfers/approvals are at L92-L136 and refund/redemption burns occur at Raffle.sol:L320-L325, L357-L365.
fixed ReentrancyGuard slot: held across the function by Raffle.sol:L212 and ReentrancyGuard.sol:L35-L37, L69-L105.
factory implementation/registry state: read by Raffle.sol:L598-L604 and defined/written at RaffleFactory.sol:L41-L54, L89-L91, L105-L125.
openQuestions: unclear; need to inspect the deployed quote-token implementation and deployment evidence to confirm canonical identity and exact grossAmount balance-delta semantics; the target contains only its interface, trust requirement, and factory code/decimal checks (IRaffle.sol:L12-L15; IRaffleFactory.sol:L7-L9; RaffleFactory.sol:L66-L78).
